title: diag.7: GPS — PPS interrupt verification
description: After first GPS fix (GGA fix quality > 0), start a 10s timer. If PPS GPIO interrupt count is still 0 when timer fires, report DIAG_GPS_NO_PPS with the expected pin. Log the PPS rate when working (should be 1.000 Hz ± 1%). Detects wrong PPS GPIO or interrupt config.
